notes.title: Action Coin Pusher! A Spiritual Successor!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello!👋🏻[/h3]
I come to you today to announce something very special, made possible by [b]your direct support[/b] of You Must Become A Lich. Many of the players expressed that they wish the game was harder or that there was more to do. As a direct response, I've designed another Coin Pusher specifically for those who want more ACTION in their games!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3111550/ACP_Action_Coin_Pusher/
[h3]ACP: Action Coin Pusher will be part of the Steam Next Fest, just like YMBaL was last year. 
[/h3]

I have been working [i]really[/i] hard on this one, harder than any game I've made before. I sincerely hope you like it 🙇🏻

notes.title: Patch V1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44054378/ef7124179f99d10d4ec6340ab31dce55d607b842.png[/img]
[h1]Highlight: Pushers Improved[/h1]
"The controls are bad", this was the main complaint I heard. Well worry no more, the way you interact pushers have been redesigned completely. Now you can aim more directly, and you can even move your aim on the Y-Axis!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced Texture Noise
[*] Redesigned Controls to allow for more complex interactions
[*] Controls can be seen on the pause menu
[*] Added a Sprint Button
[*] Changes to lighting
[*] Bar fills between gem drops reduced from 3-5 to 2-4 (less time between gem drops)
[*] Boss timers no longer increase if coins are pushed during the boss fight
[*] Updated Input detection
[*] Cauldron now defaults to common crafting recipe when you open it
[/list]
[h3]Pushers[/h3]
[list]
[*] Redesigned the way the pushers are interacted with entirely
[*] The player now moves a target directly instead of navigating with their lich
[*] Added a presentation platform for the player to show off their customizations while playing
[*] Coin Launch Cooldown timer added to the coin display
[*] Final table coins per launch reduced to 3 from 4
[*] Final table pin and ring placement adjustments to prevent chests and gems from getting stuck
[/list]
[h3]WarRoom[/h3]
[list]
[*] Collectible Shelf interaction removed
[*] Clipping added to Mimic to prevent getting stuck
[*] War Table properly takes you to the last beaten zone in the third world
[/list]

As usual, if you encounter any bugs please let me know. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: New Graphical Style
notes.content:
[h3] Hey everyone I'm trying to be more around on Steam since every other social media is a dumpster fire currently.[/h3]
I was talking to Daniel recently and he mentioned that the world was lookin a little flat. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44054378/c3bc77bd8e305abeb76230d8bb8f35af70ac22a2.png[/img]
And while I knew I had more work to do on this level, I agreed. After finishing up the details on this level (More on that in a future blogpost), I sat down and genuinely tried to explore new art styles for the game again. Yet another polishing pass but this time focused on graphics. Before I did that, however, I spent a whole day optimizing the shaders I use and how the lighting is handled for the world. Overall, FPS on Best graphical setting increased by 15-20 in all scenarios, averaging around 100fps total on my machine. I'm hopeful that this will pass on anything made in the last generation of hardware. 

Be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2414190/You_Must_Become_A_Lich/]sign up for the beta test[/url] to help me polish the first couple of tables in the game, very soon.

[h3]Speaking of the demo,[/h3] the old Itch demo has been removed from Steam. You can still play it there but it will never be updated again. The game is simply too different now for the demo to be updatable. Everything is different. (More on that too in a future blogpost)

[h3]Okay so what changed?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44054378/ed675f84dc795cdaaa14efbdb03e0dd72dfa9025.png[/img]
[b]LOTS[/b]

So much that I had to update [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2414190/You_Must_Become_A_Lich/]the store page[/url] again! 

[list]
[*] New Combat Equations
[*] New Monster Parts
[*] New Pusher Boards
[*] New Mechanics
[/list]

BTW, Do you draw or animate in any way? Want to be part of this project? I'm looking for people with non-gamedev skills to assist me in making marketing material for this game. Hit me up on [url=https://discord.gg/tyC8JGT8yG]the Discord[/url], or email me at ymbal@skylorbeck.website with a subject about what you do.
